newsitem.title: USA: CBOT rice ends firm but in tight trading range.
newsitem.headline: CBOT rice ends firm but in tight trading range.

text.p: CBOT rice futures closed mostly firm but the market remained in a tight trading range with a significant volume of orders above and below the market, traders said.
"The U.S. market is very quiet and the world market prices coming out this afternoon should give the market some direction," a trader said.
Traders said rallies continue to be thwarted by weakness in the Asian market and ideas the benchmark Thai market this week will be offered below $320.00 per tonne.
Rice futures volume was estimated by the CBOT at 350 contracts, above the 222 traded Monday.
Rice futures closed one cent per cwt higher to four lower, with January up one at $10.51 per cwt.
